syllabus_topics: Graphical representation of static and dynamic data using R software.
Concept of probability. Conditional probability and law of total probability. Bayes' Theorem. Independence.
Types of random variables (discrete and continuous). Distribution function. Probability mass function and probability density function. Expected value, variance, and quantiles.
Random pairs and linear combination of random variables. Central Limit Theorem.
Introduction to statistical inference. Point estimation and interval estimation.
Construction of hypothesis tests in the classical context of observation samples from populations with Normal distribution. Goodness-of-fit tests.
Study of linear dependence between two random variables: simple linear regression.
